clue.text: Critical remark expressed about current lesson

parts.note: a tut is a click of disapproval

indicators.note: about means the spoken word goes round the current symbol

parts.note: oral means spoken or expressed aloud
I is the physics symbol for electric current

explanation.surface: A teacher's disapproving comment delivered aloud during a lesson on electricity.
explanation.definitionFit: A tutorial is a teaching session, a small-group lesson with a tutor.

clue.text: Expert of say, tea plant?

indicators.note: say means the drink's name is said as the letter it sounds like

parts.note: the drink tea is said like the letter T
an aster is a daisy-like flowering plant

explanation.surface: Is an expert on tea a kind of plant?
explanation.walkthrough: The question mark flags that the expert is a tea taster.
explanation.definitionFit: A taster is an expert employed to judge quality by sampling, as tea and wine tasters do.

clue.text: Support boss supporting Tory leader

indicators.note: in a down answer, supporting means lying beneath the other piece
leader means the opening letter of Tory

parts.note: a boss is a stud or knob, like a rivet head

explanation.surface: A boss backing the Conservative party leader.
explanation.definitionFit: A trivet is a three-legged stand that supports a pot or kettle.

clue.text: Rather an Indian tandoori accompaniment initially

definitions.text: Rather an Indian tandoori accompaniment initially

indicators.note: initially means the first letter of each of the five words

explanation.surface: A rather Indian side dish served with tandoori.
explanation.definitionFit: Raita is a yoghurt side dish served with Indian food such as tandoori meat.

clue.text: Convenience, gents in first-class, thankfully vacant

indicators.note: in means the men are put inside the first-class rating

parts.note: A1 means first-class, with the 1 read as I
gents are men

indicators.note: vacant means the word is emptied, keeping only its outer letters

explanation.surface: A first-class gents' toilet, thankfully unoccupied.
explanation.walkthrough: 'Convenience' and 'gents' suggest a British public toilet, but the answer is a facility in general.
explanation.definitionFit: An amenity is a useful facility or convenience.

clue.text: Swift reverse exit, all empty road

indicators.note: all three words are emptied, keeping just their first and last letters

explanation.surface: A driver quickly reverses out of a deserted road.
explanation.definitionFit: A street is a road in a town, so the two are synonyms.

clue.text: Penetrating cry following split, bottom to top

indicators.note: following means the cry comes after
in a down answer, the last letter of the split word moves to the top

parts.note: a rent is a split or tear
a chant is a repeated cry

explanation.surface: A cry after a split that ran from bottom to top.
explanation.walkthrough: 'bottom to top' turns RENT into TREN.
explanation.definitionFit: Trenchant means incisive or cutting, as a penetrating remark is.

clue.text: Charm has worked for one in allure

indicators.note: for means one piece replaces the other

parts.note: to entice is to allure or tempt
one is I, the Roman numeral
a machine that ran has worked or operated

explanation.surface: A charm that has worked its allure on someone.
explanation.definitionFit: To entrance is to charm or enchant, holding someone spellbound.

clue.text: Time's comfort missing first small pet

parts.note: T is the abbreviation for time; the 's is 'is'

indicators.note: missing first means the earlier of the two S letters is dropped

parts.note: to reassure is to comfort

explanation.surface: Time is a comfort when you lose your first small pet.
explanation.definitionFit: A pet or darling is a treasure, someone held dear.

clue.text: Sparkling fizzy drink one's imbibed — then died

indicators.note: imbibed means taken in, so the numeral goes inside the drink

parts.note: Sprite is a brand of lemonade
one is I, the Roman numeral; the 's is 'is'
D is the abbreviation for died in genealogies

explanation.surface: Someone drank a fizzy drink and then died.
explanation.walkthrough: 'Sparkling' looks as if it describes the drink, but it is the definition in its lively sense.
explanation.definitionFit: Sparkling and spirited both describe someone lively and full of energy.

clue.text: Delicate low-down check, tense at start

parts.note: gen is slang for information, the low-down

indicators.note: the tense letter, T, is moved to the start of the word for check

parts.note: let means hindrance or check, as in 'without let or hindrance'

explanation.surface: A tense moment checking out some delicate information.
explanation.walkthrough: 'tense at start' moves the T of LET to the front, giving TLE.
explanation.definitionFit: Gentle and delicate both mean soft and light in touch.

clue.text: Pink skin around tattoos

indicators.note: around means the answer sits in and about the words pink skin

explanation.surface: Tattoos spread across pink skin.
explanation.definitionFit: A tattooist inks a design into skin, so to ink is to tattoo.

clue.text: Height of ecstasy accepting heartless valentine back

indicators.note: accepting means the joyful word takes the other letters inside it

parts.note: elation is great joy, ecstasy

indicators.note: back means the remaining letters are read in reverse
heartless means the inside of valentine is removed, leaving its ends

explanation.surface: The peak of happiness on receiving a valentine.
explanation.walkthrough: 'heartless' leaves the outer letters of valentine, and 'back' turns them round before 'accepting' puts them inside the word for ecstasy.
explanation.definitionFit: An elevation is a high point or height above a level.

clue.text: Men with love for power creating anarchy

indicators.note: for means one letter takes the place of the other

parts.note: chaps are men
P is the physics abbreviation for power
love is zero, O, in tennis

explanation.surface: Men who love power stir up anarchy.
explanation.definitionFit: Chaos is utter disorder, the state anarchy brings.

clue.text: With pressure removed, swimmer makes wild party

indicators.note: removed means the pressure letter is taken out

parts.note: a porgy is a sea fish

explanation.surface: A swimmer, freed from pressure, throws a wild party.
explanation.definitionFit: An orgy is a wild, debauched party or revel.

clue.text: State again raised European bank charge

indicators.note: in a down answer, raised means the word for bank is written upwards

parts.note: a tier is a bank or row
a rate is a charge or fee

explanation.surface: A European bank raised its charges.
explanation.walkthrough: 'raised' looks as if it describes the charge, but in this down answer it sends the European bank upwards.
explanation.definitionFit: To reiterate is to say again, to repeat a statement.

clue.text: In shorter supply, such air's clear, oddly

indicators.note: oddly means the first, third, fifth and other odd-numbered letters are taken

explanation.surface: Clean air is rare these days.
explanation.definitionFit: Scarcer is the comparative of scarce, meaning less plentiful.

clue.text: Amateur artist-turned-rapper's musical

indicators.note: turned means the artist's letters are reversed

parts.note: RA is a Royal Academician, an artist
an MC is a rapper; the 's is 'is'
Hair is the 1960s rock musical

explanation.surface: An amateur painter who became a rapper stars in a musical.
explanation.definitionFit: An armchair critic is a theoretical amateur, not a practitioner.

clue.text: Writer's block not beginning to block phrase

indicators.note: to block means the letters enclose the next piece
not beginning means the first letter is removed

parts.note: to resist is to block or oppose
to say is to phrase or express

explanation.surface: Writer's block is starting to stop the words coming.
explanation.walkthrough: 'block' appears twice: first as the word for oppose, then as the containment signal. 'not beginning' drops its first letter.
explanation.definitionFit: An essayist is a writer of essays.

clue.text: China is sure to take over neighbour?

indicators.note: over means the lifted letters are turned round and read backwards
to take means the letters are lifted out of the run of words China is sure

explanation.surface: China is bound to annex the country next door.
explanation.walkthrough: 'China' looks like the country itself, but its last two letters start the backward run.
explanation.definitionFit: A person from Russia, which borders China, is a neighbour; the question mark flags the example.

clue.text: Prison then go off with form

definitions.meaning: to go off with something is to steal it

explanation.surface: Jail, then running off with a form.
explanation.definitionFit: The one slang word means jail, to steal, and condition.

clue.text: Wife and husband admitting sex together

indicators.note: admitting means the couple's letters let the word for sex in between

parts.note: it is a coy word for sex

explanation.surface: A married couple make love together.
explanation.definitionFit: With means in the company of, along with, as together does.

clue.text: More attentive grasping sweetheart's comparatively bored

indicators.note: grasping means the attentive word holds the letter inside

parts.note: warier means more cautious, more alert
the heart of sweet is its middle letter E

explanation.surface: A more attentive sweetheart is comparatively bored.
explanation.walkthrough: 'sweetheart' is the middle of 'sweet', E, not a lover.
explanation.definitionFit: Wearier is the comparative of weary, meaning more tired and bored.

clue.text: Hip measurement reportedly cut

parts.note: in means fashionable, hip

indicators.note: reportedly means the measurement word is heard rather than spelt

parts.note: size is a measurement

explanation.surface: The hip measurement was reportedly cut down.
explanation.walkthrough: 'Hip' looks like the body part, but it means fashionable.
explanation.definitionFit: To incise is to cut into a surface.

clue.text: Beginning of stag party escalated in bars

indicators.note: in a down answer, escalated means the letters climb upward, read in reverse
beginning of means the first letter of stag

parts.note: a revel is a lively party

explanation.surface: The start of a stag party escalated in some bars.
explanation.definitionFit: Levers are bars used to prise or lift, such as crowbars.

clue.text: Casanova's first libertine to follow bird

indicators.note: to follow puts the libertine after the initial
first means just the opening letter of the name

parts.note: a rake is a dissolute libertine

explanation.surface: Casanova's first conquest goes to a libertine chasing a girl.
explanation.walkthrough: 'bird' looks like slang for a woman in the Casanova story, but it is a real bird.
explanation.definitionFit: A crake is a bird of the rail family, such as the corncrake.

clue.text: Question Church and State adopting constitution at last

indicators.note: adopting means the stating word takes in a letter

parts.note: allege means state or assert

indicators.note: at last means the final letter of constitution

explanation.surface: Questioning the constitutional link between Church and State.
explanation.definitionFit: To challenge a claim is to question or dispute it.

clue.text: Look good in charge showing sense

parts.note: lo is an old word for look

explanation.surface: Looking good in charge shows good sense.
explanation.definitionFit: Logic means sound reasoning, good sense.

clue.text: The French tweeter's flipping sensual

indicators.note: flipping means the letters are turned over, read backwards

parts.note: la is French for the
a mina, or mynah, is a talking bird; the 's is 'is'

explanation.surface: A French tweeter swears while being sensual.
explanation.walkthrough: 'flipping' looks like a mild oath, but it turns LAMINA round.
explanation.definitionFit: Animal as an adjective means physical or carnal, relating to bodily desire.

clue.text: Dress up small vocal characters trailing princess

indicators.note: trailing means the other pieces come after the princess

parts.note: Di is Princess Diana

indicators.note: vocal means the word for characters is said aloud

parts.note: guys are characters, fellows

explanation.surface: Little singers dress up to follow a princess.
explanation.definitionFit: To disguise something is to dress it up so it is not recognised.

clue.text: Johnny's off?

parts.note: His surname also means gone off, decayed

explanation.surface: Has Johnny left?
explanation.walkthrough: Johnny Rotten (John Lydon) fronted the punk band the Sex Pistols.
explanation.definitionFit: Food that has gone off is decayed, and a punk singer's surname supplies the same word.

clue.text: On credit money's not all there

parts.note: CR is the accounting abbreviation for credit
ackers is British slang for money; the 's is 'is'

explanation.surface: Running up credit when the money isn't all there.
explanation.walkthrough: ACKERS is old British slang for cash.
explanation.definitionFit: Crackers is slang for mad, someone mentally not all there.
